title: I've been making an HD-2D JRPG about a thief with ridiculous luck, and Chapter 1 is out as a free demo
author: MotherVehkingMuatra
selftext:
Hey! I've been working on Luck of Lumbaris, a story-driven HD-2D JRPG set in a world I've been writing for years.



You play a young thief who steals the wrong loaf of bread and ends up face to face with Luminya, the goddess of luck. She picks him as her champion and won't say why. Along the way he picks up a shy bunnykin healer, among other companions.



Combat is turn-based. You break enemies' Wards to get them Jinxed (they lose a turn and take double damage), you can toss Luminya's coin to swing a fight, pairs can do Duo Arts, and the whole party can go All In together.



The full game is planned at ten chapters. Chapter 1 is out now as a free demo, about an hour, and the Steam page is on the way.



On the Claude side: Claude Code is basically my dev partner in Godot 4. What helped most was keeping every decision in a rulebook in the repo, with checks that enforce it, so I'm not repeating myself every session. There's also a bot that plays the whole chapter and tells me where it gets stuck, which has made my own playtesting lot more focused. The art is AI-generated and cleaned up by me, some supporting text is drafted from my notes and rewritten + approved by me, and the world, story and characters are mine. Ask me anything about the setup.



You can grab the free Chapter 1 demo [here](https://lumbaris-games.itch.io/luck-of-lumbaris), and the Discord is [here](https://discord.gg/M654fXzy5R) if you want to know when the Steam page goes up.



Would love to know what you think, good or bad!
